title: SpaceX and Tesla Boards Form Special Committees to Explore Merger; Musk Calls Tie-Up a 'Good Idea'
summary: Elon Musk confirmed on SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings call (Oct. 20) that both companies' boards have formed independent special committees to explore a potential merger, with Musk recusing himself as a conflicted party. No terms have been agreed and no guarantee of a deal. The combined entity would be worth roughly $3.5 trillion, the largest corporate tie-up in history if completed. SpaceX shares surged ~10% in premarket trading.
why: 特斯拉(TSLA)持仓关键事件：并购讨论正式化将推升TSLA和SPCX短期隐含波动率，sell put的行权区间风险需重新评估；若并购最终落地将是史上最大规模企业重组，估值重估幅度巨大；同时SpaceX Q3业绩超预期、AI营收激增也利好市场情绪。

title: 国资委筹备组建国家数据集团央企即将挂牌，数据要素板块港股A股走强
summary: 据中国证券报和财联社报道，国资委正筹备组建新央企国家数据集团，消息称近日将正式挂牌成立，主要职责为整合能源、交通、金融、医疗等领域数据资产、打破数据孤岛、构建统一数据要素市场。消息催化A股及港股数据要素、物理AI相关概念股走强。
why: 国家数据集团的成立将打造全国统一数据要素市场，有助于腾讯云、阿里云、AI基础设施等数字经济相关持仓标的的中长期估值；港股物理AI概念股受政策预期驱动，可关注相关标的短期波动机会。

title: SpaceX Q3 2026 Earnings Beat Estimates; AI and Starlink Drive Revenue Surge
summary: SpaceX reported Q3 2026 results on Oct. 20, with profit beating analyst estimates on a large jump in AI business revenue. Q2 2026 revenue was $7.8B (+91.9% YoY) with AI revenue up 247.5% YoY to $2.6B and connectivity up 65.8% to $4.3B; SpaceX targets a $100B annualized revenue run rate by year-end. The Q3 beat drove shares up ~10% in premarket and triggered the merger announcement with Tesla.
why: SpaceX与特斯拉(TSLA)的合并是这次财报的最重要背景——盈利超预期让合并溢价空间更大；对于TSLA持有者，合并讨论+SpaceX业绩高增长共同推升TSLA隐含波动率，sell put策略需关注。美股AI/科技板块整体受提振。
